5130031.en: {call|B|A}, it's forbidden to harm someone from the same Sect. You should understand this very well as a Disciple, yet you still violated the rule. After discussion, the authorities have decided: {0}.
5130031.ch: {callSchool|A}，同门相残乃是宗门大忌，阁下身为弟子，明知故犯，其罪不小。经高层商讨后决定，{0}。

5130041.en: {call|B|A}, it's forbidden to harm someone from the same Sect. Even though you, {post|A}, are of a high position, you're not exempt from the rule. As a result of your actions, {0}. Please be more prudent from now on.
5130041.ch: {callSchool|A}，同门相残乃是宗门大忌，{post|A}您虽位高权重，但行出此事终究不妥。您的行为已然导致{0}，望您三思而行，好自为之。

5121002.en: {post|A}, my beloved disciple {name|B} has great strength and is up to the task of this competition.
5121002.ch: {post|A}，我的爱徒{name|B}，实力高超，可胜任此次大比。

5121003.en: I will dedicate myself to the Sect!

5121004.en: I will do everything within my capabilities for the Sect.

5121005.en: Your disciple {name|B}'s strength is one of the greatest of the younger generation, as {name|A} has said.
5121005.ch: 贵徒{name|B}力在年轻一辈也算是翘楚，就依{name|A}所言。

5121006.en: I am grateful for {post|A}'s great kindness!

5121007.en: Thank you {post|A} and {post|B} for the care. This disciple will do their utmost to win this competition for the Sect.
5121007.ch: 感谢{post|A}和{post|B}抬爱，弟子定当竭尽全力为宗门赢得此次大比。

5121014.en: I feel that {name|A}'s strength is not enough to win the Sect Tournament.
5121014.ch: 我觉得{name|A}的能力未能胜任宗门大比。

5121015.en: Is the last challenger coming up to measure themselves against me?
5121015.ch: 最后的挑战者是否上来与我一较高低？

5121016.en: {name|A} might just as well get on the platform and show off!

5121018.en: Let me assess you! Take this!
5121018.ch: 就让我来会一会您！看招！

5121020.en: You're very strong! I am satisfied with my loss.
5121020.ch: 你很强！此次落败，我心服口服。

5121021.en: I got lucky this time! You are very good, {name|A}!
5121021.ch: 看来这次是我侥幸赢了！{name|A}，你也很强啊！

5121022.en: Please impart some wisdom to me!

5140001.en: {name|B|A}, would you go to the forest behind the mountain and harvest a basket of <r>red Spiritual Fruit with green streaks</r> for me? I've got a lot on right now and can't get away... Thanks!
5140001.ch: {call|B|A}，烦请你去后山园林之中为在下采摘一筐<r>红里透绿</r>的灵果，我眼下正需急用却脱不开身，多有麻烦。

5140011.en: Arriving at the temple, you notice a pair of disciples sharing a private moment.
5140011.ch: 你来到这处宫观，发现竟有一对男女弟子私会于此！

5140012.en: On hearing you enter, they discreetly take their leave. Somewhat sheepishly, the man leaves behind a small gift for you.
5140012.ch: 二人听到动静，识相离去，男子心虚之余，还给你留下薄礼一份。

5140013.en: On hearing you enter, they both turn to look at you, and then leave the area scowling.
5140013.ch: 二人听到动静，一齐转头瞪视着你，随后才悻悻离去。

5140014.en: Arriving at the temple, an Elder is giving a Disciple instruction.
5140014.ch: 你来到这处宫观，一名长老正在给一名弟子传功。

5140015.en: Watching quietly from the sidelines, you watch the entire process unfold and learn quite a lot. The Elder must have sensed your presence and continued the lesson for your benefit.
5140015.ch: 你蹑足潜踪，全程观看了长老对真传弟子传功过程，获益良多。想必长老也觉察到了你的存在，想顺手赐予你这番造化，刻意没有点破而已。

5140016.en: After a moment of hesitation, you enter the temple, but step on a leaf and startle the Disciple who starts to bleed profusely from the nose. You get the hell out of there.
5140016.ch: 你才进入此处宫观，不想一脚踏上落叶，发出轻声，而那名弟子受到惊扰，竟然喷出鼻血数斗。你赶忙逃离了此地。

5140017.en: Arriving at the temple, there is a Bambuki inside, practicing its sword technique!
5140017.ch: 你来到这处宫观，竟有一只竹妖在里面横斩竖劈，修炼剑法！

5140018.en: The Sword Bambuki is still inside training.
5140018.ch: 剑竹妖还在此处练剑，尚未离去。

5140019.en: You defeat the Bambuki, clean up the temple and remove the body. You went above and beyond the call of duty, earning the praise of the Elders.
5140019.ch: 你打败了竹妖，把这处宫观和妖兽的尸体全都打扫了，超额完成任务，得到了长老的赞赏。

5140020.en: After scooping up some water, you hear noise up ahead. Following it, you find under the shade of a tree a raven-haired Disciple girl bathing naked in a pool, her facing you.
5140020.ch: 打好水后，你忽闻前方有些声响。循声走去，树木掩映之下，你竟发现一个挽起一个乌黑发髻的女弟子背对你赤身浸在潭中。

5140021.en: But when "she" suddenly stands up, you notice her back is all muscle, and the side of her face is covered in whiskers. He winks at you and says "You care to join me?"
5140021.ch: 可“她”突然站起，竟然露出浑身结实肌肉，转过头来还是一张须眉男儿面目。他对你挤眉弄眼，问道：你也来泡澡么？

5140022.en: Your appearance startles the girl, who raises her hand with a burst of Tao power, and slaps you unconscious...
5140022.ch: 这名女弟子发现了你，失惊之下，道力迸发，竟扬手将你拍晕过去……

5140023.en: Arriving at the Holy Spring, a curtain of water is tumbling into the pool. Suddenly a Carpia Boss pops up in the water!
5140023.ch: 你刚到灵泉水潭，面前哗啦一下扬起一重水幕，而里面竟然窜出一只鲮鱼精来！

5140024.en: The Carpia is still roaming around in this area.
5140024.ch: 鲮鱼还在此处徘徊，尚未离去。

5140025.en: You defeat the Carpia Boss, which dives back under the water and flees the scene.
5140025.ch: 鲮鱼精为你所败，慌乱中钻入水中，迅速窜逃而去。

5140026.en: You're just speaking with an old man when you run into some bandits who are blocking the road.
5140026.ch: 你刚与老者接洽，没想就遇强盗拦路。

5140027.en: The bandits are still at large, waiting for their next target.
5140027.ch: 强盗仍在原地徘徊，似是在等待目标。

5140028.en: Beaten and bloody, the bandits flee down the road, helter-skelter. The old man nods at you slightly and continues walking towards the Sect.
5140028.ch: 强盗死伤惨重、如鸟兽散。老者微微颔首，径自朝宗门走去了。

5140029.en: There is a giant toad squatting in the road ahead. The moment it sees you, it tries to swallow you whole.
5140029.ch: 前面一只巨型蟾蜍，蹲坐路心，看见你来，随即猛张大口向你咬来！

5140030.en: The giant toad is still squatting in the road, looking menacing.
5140030.ch: 巨型蟾蜍仍在原地蹲坐，凶神恶煞。

5140031.en: You defeat the toad. It turns back into a normal sized toad and hops away, as fast as it can go. The old man bursts out laughing, then strides off towards the Sect.
5140031.ch: 你击败蟾蜍，它随即化为一只小小青蛙，惊慌失措的溜走了。老者见此情形哈哈大笑，健步朝宗门走去。

5140032.en: A mysterious figure is setting up a seat in an abandoned Taoist Temple. He claims it is a Qi-powered magic seat that can unlock your meridians without need for cultivation. After a brief explanation, he heartily invites you to sit down and try it out.
5140032.ch: 荒观之中，一名神秘男人正在搭建一张椅子。据他说，这是一张不用修炼也能打通体内脉络的神椅，用灵气供能。一番解说后，他盛情邀请你坐上去一试。

5140033.en: You hesitate for a moment, but then agree, not wanting to disappoint him. You sit down and the chair starts moving. It feels like a thousand pairs of tiny hands are all massaging you at once. Your limbs tingle and you're pretty sure your meridians are unblocking!
5140033.ch: 你将信将疑，不忍辜负他的一番好意。坐上去后，椅子发动起来，竟似乎有无数双手对你进行推拿。你感觉全身酥麻，经脉不禁更加畅通了些许！

5140034.en: You hesitate for a moment, but then agree, not wanting to disappoint him. You sit down. It feels like a thousand pairs of hands are poking you. It's total agony! Unable to stand it, you start to retch...
5140034.ch: 你将信将疑，不忍辜负他的一番好意。坐上去后，椅子竟似有无数双手对你进行按压，你感觉全身剧痛，没坚持一阵，立即呕吐不止……

5140035.en: A giant Monkey Demon appears in the temple and reaches out to grab you!
5140035.ch: 道观之中，一个庞大的猴妖突然出现在你面前，它竟突然出手抓你！

5140036.en: The Money Demon jumps up and down, making itself at home in the temple.
5140036.ch: 猴妖上蹿下跳，似乎想把道观占为己有。

5140037.en: You show the Monkey Demon the extent of your cultivation, and it flees, covered in wounds. A second later, there is no sign of it...
5140037.ch: 见你道法通神，猴妖带着满身伤痕逃离而去，眨眼间便失去了踪影……

5140038.en: Completing your Geomancy, you happen to notice a dark object flying through the air. It sees you looking up, and rushes towards you, laughing madly.
5140038.ch: 你堪舆已毕，只见无意中个黑乎乎的东西飞了过来，它见你抬头，桀桀怪笑两声后朝你扑来。

5140039.en: The malevolent mask moves this way and that, as though devising some diabolical plan.
5140039.ch: 邪气四溢的假面滴溜溜乱转，仿佛酝酿这着什么阴谋。

5140040.en: Near a locus of geomantic power, a man in Taoist robes is scouting the area. He says there is a cave up ahead, the entrance to Tiger Pass, wherein the water from eight cardinal directions gathers.
5140040.ch: 风水宝地之中，一名道服男子正在周围勘察。他说面前山穴，乃是一处虎关之口，专门吞吐八方之水。

5140041.en: No sooner has he finished speaking, than a great column of water bursts out of the cave mouth, knocking the Feng Shui Master off his feet...
5140041.ch: 才一说完，山穴里头喷射出一股水柱将风水大师冲走……

5140042.en: Sensing you do not believe him, the man in Taoist robes turns to face the cave and shouts "Water of the Eight Ways!" A ferocious wind starts blowing from the cave, like a great voice speaking to the priest. You leave at once, your ears ringing.
5140042.ch: 这名道服男子觉得你不相信，对着洞穴叫声“八方之水”。他才一说完，里面突然刮起一阵狂风，似乎在和道士攀比嗓门。你耳膜生疼，立刻遁离此地。

5140043.en: No sooner has he finished speaking, than a ferocious wind starts blowing from the cave, like a great voice speaking to the priest. You leave at once, your ears ringing.
5140043.ch: 他才一说完，里面突然刮起一阵狂风，似乎在和道士攀比嗓门。你耳膜生疼，立刻遁离此地。

5140044.en: Arriving in the village, you give the villagers evil-dispelling charms to stick up around the place.
5140044.ch: 来到村中，你给村民发放辟邪的符箓在各处张贴。

5140045.en: Dark miasma fills the air as hundreds of demons are driven out of their hiding places and away from the village.
5140045.ch: 村周围突然黑气四起，原来是潜藏的妖物被符箓之力激发，统统显形而出

5140046.en: Dark miasma smothers the village as the Shades linger.
5140046.ch: 黑气盘旋村周，阴魂不散。

5140047.en: On entering the village, you see a so-called Disciple fraternizing with the locals, relieving them of Spirit Stones and generally being an ass.
5140047.ch: 刚进入村落，你就看到了有个记名弟子正左拥右抱、收取灵石，还颐指气使地呼喝凡人。

5140049.en: Seeing you, the Disciple drops the bag of Spirit Stones and runs away, holding his head in his hands.
5140049.ch: 这名弟子看到你，一把抛下满兜的灵石，捂着脸头也不回地逃走了。

5140050.en: A mob of monsters is threatening the village. We are too afraid to go out at night. Master, please help us solve our problem!
5140050.ch: 村庄附近来了一伙妖物，我等日夜不敢出村一步，还望仙长为我等排忧解难！

5140051.en: There's bad energy coming from the mountains yonder. Lots of monsters must be holed up in there.
5140051.ch: 后山里妖气充溢，定有不少妖兽在此盘踞。

5140052.en: Evil energy fills the air, sending a shiver down your spine.
5140052.ch: 妖气弥漫四周，令人不寒而栗。

5140053.en: You arrive at the place. All you find is a man dressed in dark robes. He glances at you and snorts.
5140053.ch: 你来到传闻所说的地点，只见有一人全身笼罩在黑袍之中，他淡淡看了你一眼，从鼻子眼里挤出几个音节。

5140054.en: Foundation Manual, Rare, 100 million Spirit Stones each
5140054.ch: 筑基秘籍，蓝色品质，一亿灵石一本。

5140055.en: Qi Refining Manual, Uncommon, 500 million Spirit Stones each
5140055.ch: 炼气秘籍，绿色品质，五亿灵石一本。

5140056.en: Mortal Manual, Common, 1 billion Spirit Stones each
5140056.ch: 凡人秘籍，白色品质，十亿灵石一本。

5140057.en: The man in black laughs softly, takes the Spirit Stones from you and hands you an object shrouded in energy.
5140057.ch: 黑衣人轻笑一声，从你手中接过灵石，并把一团用灵力隔绝探查的物体递了过来。

5140058.en: "You're not trying to fool me are you?" He laughs coldly, then explodes into motion, charging right at you.
5140058.ch: “莫非你在耍我不成？”黑衣人冷哼一声，身形暴起，冲了过来。

5140059.en: "You must have a death wish!" He smiles at you enigmatically.
5140059.ch: “还敢前来寻死！”黑衣人似笑非笑地看着你。

5140060.en: You trace out the Eight Trigrams on the floor and start to scry. Disciples sit around you in a circle.
5140060.ch: 你在地上画出八卦开始展示推演之法，众弟子端坐围绕一圈。

5140061.en: Suddenly a section of the circle blazes into light. Over in that direction, dark energy emerges from the earth, like lurking monsters angered by your scrying.
5140061.ch: 突然，八卦的某个方向光芒大亮，沿着该方向看去，一缕黑气从地底冒出，似有躲藏妖物因推演勘破而愤然现身。

5140062.en: The Disciples are startled, looking on in wonder.
5140062.ch: 观此异象，一众弟子瞪大双眼，面露惊诧。

5140063.en: The monsters face off against the Disciples. Tensions are running high.
5140063.ch: 妖物正与一众弟子隔空对峙，气氛十分紧张。

5140064.en: Suddenly a section of the circle blazes into light. Over in that direction, bright energy emerges from the earth, as if an ancient treasure has been revealed by your scrying.
5140064.ch: 突然，八卦的某个方向光芒大亮，沿着该方向看去，一缕金光从地底冒出，似有秘宝因被勘破而与推演之力相互和应。

5140065.en: The Disciples applaud loudly, in appreciation.
5140065.ch: 观此异象，一众弟子纷纷拍手、啧啧称奇。

5140067.en: Monsters have taken up residence here. The Array Core is slightly damaged.
5140067.ch: 一群妖兽盘踞于此，阵眼已有部分被破坏。

5140068.en: Monsters are wrecking the Array Core. We need to clear them out!
5140068.ch: 妖兽仍在此地破坏阵眼，我宗必须尽快将其清除。

5140069.en: You drive off the monsters and repair the Array Core.
5140069.ch: 你驱赶了妖兽，并将阵眼修复完好。

5140070.en: Heaven is ruthless and treats all men like...?

5140072.en: Beauty blinds the eye. Music deafens the ear. Delicious food...?
5140072.ch: 五色令人目盲，五音令人耳聋，五味令人？

5140074.en: So... you belong to the Sect. Go on, hand over the letter.
5140074.ch: 唔……原来是宗门的自己人，把信拿来吧。

5140076.en: The man in black takes the letter, then vanishes where he stands.
5140076.ch: 黑衣人接过信，倏地一下消失在了原地。

5140077.en: Moving closer, you notice he's a regular person, acting all mysterious, in an attempt to deceive people.
5140077.ch: 你前去一看，发现不过是一个凡人在装神弄鬼，试图恐吓他人来敛财。

5140078.en: Noticing the powerful aura coming off you, your opponent freaks out and heads for the hills.
5140078.ch: 对方眼见你身上散发出异于凡人的威压，心中惊骇万分，撒腿逃跑了。

5140079.en: As you approach, a female ghost clad in red and cloaked in powerful energy floats towards you. Her hair stands up on end, and her clothes are all in tatters, like she just had a fight with a thunderstorm.
5140079.ch: 你刚要靠近，一个红衣女鬼裹挟着强大的威压朝你飘来，其人头发全都竖起，衣服也破破烂烂，似乎是刚遭遇雷劫。

5140080.en: I have cultivated for many years but cannot pass the final trial. My enemies are ruthless; there is nothing they will not do, and they have all succeeded! The unfairness of it eats away at me.
5140080.ch: 我修行多年，勤勤恳恳，却没渡过这天劫。而我的敌人，烧杀抢掠无恶不作，却成功渡劫。我心中实在不甘！

5140081.en: That's just how it is. Struggle all you like, but if you don't reincarnate, you'll be back again, walking the Heavenly Path next time.
5140081.ch: 天意如此，何必苦苦纠结，不如趁早转世投胎，下辈子再求天道。

5140082.en: Anyway, I'm not that talented. You can't force your way through bottlenecks and wasting all your time on cultivation and playing the hero is a joke...
5140082.ch: 也罢，我资质驽钝，本不该强行冲击瓶颈，却妄想修成大道、行侠仗义，终究是一场笑话……

5140083.en: She starts to disappear. Looks like she's letting go of the past...
5140083.ch: 眼前的身影逐渐消散，看来她已然放下了过往执念。

5140084.en: Ha, ridiculous. I don't believe all this talk of destiny. If I die here today, is that my destiny too?
5140084.ch: 哼，可笑，我偏不信这宿命之说，你若今天死于这里，怕也是命中注定？

5140085.en: Huh? You're lucky to be alive. Why would you throw it all away?
5140085.ch: 嗯？你侥幸捡回一条小命竟然还想来送死？

5140086.en: You put everything into cultivation, you did your best. It's just... things don't always turn out as we want them to.
5140086.ch: 你既为修行付出一切，便已然无愧于心，只是事情的结果往往非我等一己意愿可左右……

5140087.en: So many years of cultivation and hardship, looks like it was all just wishful thinking...
5140087.ch: 多年修炼吃尽苦头，看来终究只是我一厢情愿罢了……

5140089.en: In the end it's just platitudes. How could you know my pain! The Heavenly Path is totally unfair and I'm through with it!
5140089.ch: 到头来只会说些好话，你怎知我所受之苦！如今天道待我不公，我便也顾不得那么多了！

5140201.en: {callSchool|A}, next month our Sect will attack <r>{1}</r>. Return quickly so we can prepare for battle.
5140201.ch: {callSchool|A}，我宗将于下个月对<r>{1}</r>发起进攻，请速回宗门，做好准备。

5140202.en: Lowly <r>{0}</r>, you dare challenge the honor of our Sect? Ludicrous! Today you will taste the ferocity of our Disciples!
5140202.ch: 区区<r>{0}</r>，也敢来挑战我宗的威信，实在可笑。今日，就让你见识一番我宗弟子的勇猛！

5140203.en: You dare lead your Disciples against me? Prepare to be annihilated!
5140203.ch: 既然你敢带领着弟子前来进攻我宗，那就该做好全军覆没的准备！

5140204.en: You really are getting too big for your boots. Even <r>{1}</r> has turned against me. Today my Disciples will teach you a lesson you won't soon forget!
5140204.ch: 我看你真是过于自大了，连我<r>{1}</r>都敢图谋，今日就让你看看我宗弟子的厉害！

5140205.ch: 废话不必多说了，开战吧！

5140206.en: We must win the war today! Follow my orders closely, and we will defeat <r>{1}</r>!
5140206.ch: 今日之战，只能胜，不能败！请各位弟子按照我的指示行事，这<r>{1}</r>必能被我们攻下！

5140208.en: Our Disciples are known for their bravery! We will defeat <r>{1}</r> before long.
5140208.ch: 我宗弟子向来骁勇善战！看来不需多时就能战胜<r>{1}</r>。

5140209.en: We are blessed to have a heroic leader like you. You will lead us to victory!
5140209.ch: 宗主如此英勇神武，想必在宗主大人的带领下，我们定能取得巨大优势！

5140210.en: For a rich sect like us, it's only a matter of time to conquer <r>{1}</r>!
5140210.ch: 以我宗的资源，攻下<r>{1}</r>定是不在话下！

5140211.en: The Sect Leader has always been kind to us. Today we will give it our all to win the war!
5140211.ch: 宗主向来对我们关怀有加，今日我定要用尽全力，不辜负宗主的期望！

5140212.en: Now that we have gone thus far, we must eradicate <r>{1}</r> to prevent any further threats!
5140212.ch: 斩草须得除根，既然已到如此地步，看来必须得灭掉<r>{1}</r>，永绝后患！

5140213.en: <r>{1}</r> has always been a thorn in my side. Today I'll give them what they deserve!
5140213.ch: 早就看<r>{1}</r>这些人不顺眼了，今日我定要杀个痛快！

5140214.en: That wretch just now attacked me with a despicable trick.
5140214.ch: 刚刚那人真是可恶！居然使用阴招，害我受伤。

5140215.en: I could have killed more enemies if I had not been wounded!
5140215.ch: 若不是需要休养，我定能再杀十人！

5140216.en: Alas! I want to fight alongside my brethren so much.
5140216.ch: 唉！真是苦恼，我也想与同门弟子们一齐战斗。

5140217.en: They think they can block my attacks? I really feel sorry for their ignorance!
5140217.ch: 就这些废物，还想挡住我的攻击，真是不知天高地厚！

5140218.en: They are much weaker than they look. Nothing to fear at all.
5140218.ch: 这些外强中干之人，根本不足为惧。

5140219.en: What a fight! I haven't had such pleasure in ages!
5140219.ch: 好久没有如此酣畅淋漓的战斗了！

5140220.en: It's a relief to see you intact.
5140220.ch: 你平安无事，我就放心了。

5140221.en: They are done! Let's go and capture their Array Core now.
5140221.ch: 终于解决了这些人！走，我们去将阵眼攻打下来。

5140222.en: Well done, everyone! The battle ahead will be more challenging. Keep up the good fight!
5140222.ch: 各位辛苦了！接下来的战斗更加艰险，还请众位一鼓作气。

5140224.en: Finally, some help! I'll leave the enemy to you, and I'm going back to have my wound treated.
5140224.ch: 终于有人来帮我了！你且先对付此人，我必须得回去疗伤了。

5140225.en: <r>{1}</r>'s Sect Leader is cowering in the main palace with their Guardian at the gate. Kill the Guardian, and I'll slay their leader in person.
5140225.ch: <r>{1}</r>的宗主就在主殿之上，此人依靠神兽龟缩不出。待我等合力击杀此兽，本宗主将亲自出手对付此人。

5140226.en: <r>{1}</r>'s Sect Leader is cowering in the main palace with their Guardian at the gate. Kill the Guardian, and our Sect Leader will slay their leader in person.
5140226.ch: <r>{1}</r>的宗主就在主殿之上，此人依靠神兽龟缩不出。待我等合力击杀此兽，宗主大人将亲自出手对付此人。

5140227.en: I, <r>{1}</r>, will never fall! {name|B}, I will fight you to death!
5140227.ch: 我<r>{1}</r>必不会败！{name|B}，我要与你决一死战！

5140228.en: Stop your futile resistance. You have outlived your time, and it's fate for you to perish in our hands.
5140228.ch: 不必负隅顽抗了，你们的大势已去，被我宗击败不过必然之事。

5140229.en: Follow my orders, Disciples! The final victory is at hand! Our Sect is unstoppable! Keep up the good work and seal the victory!
5140229.ch: 全体弟子听令，大战已胜利在望！我宗势气已锐不可当，诸位弟子请乘胜追击，立我宗之威！

5140231.en: {callSchool|A}, <r>{0}</r> is going to attack our sect next month. Please come back to prepare for the defense.
5140231.ch: {callSchool|A}，<r>{0}</r>将于下个月攻打我宗，请速回宗门，准备抵御入侵。

5140232.en: All our Disciples are fully prepared. {1}, your fate ends today!
5140232.ch: 我宗弟子已然做好万全准备，{1}，今日必让尔等死无葬身之地！

5140233.en: I've heard you <r>{1}</r> have quite a lot of resources. We will be rich today.
5140233.ch: 听说你们<r>{1}</r>的资源也不少，看来都要归我宗门下了。

5140234.en: Your Disciples are not only weak, but also foolish to put up a fight against us!
5140234.ch: 你宗弟子如此不堪，还想负隅顽抗，实在可笑！

5140236.en: We must win the war today! Follow my orders closely, and we will repel <r>{0}</r>!
5140236.ch: 今日之战，只能胜，不能败！请各位弟子按照我的指示行事，定能抵抗<r>{0}</r>的攻击！

5140238.en: Our Disciples are known for bravery! We can repel <r>{0}</r> before long.
5140238.ch: 我宗弟子向来骁勇善战！看来不需多时就能击退<r>{0}</r>。

5140239.en: We are blessed to have a heroic leader like you. You will lead us to repel <r>{0}</r>!
5140239.ch: 宗主如此英勇神武，想必在宗主大人的带领下，我们定能抵抗<r>{0}</r>的攻势！

5140240.en: For a big sect like us, it's only a matter of time to repel <r>{0}</r>!
5140240.ch: 以我宗的资源，抵御<r>{0}</r>定是不在话下！

5140242.en: Now that they have picked a fight, I'll crush them without mercy!
5140242.ch: 既然已被攻上门来，那就别怪我下手不客气了！

5140243.en: <r>{0}</r> has always been a thorn in my side. How dare they attack us! Today I'll give them what they deserve!
5140243.ch: 早就看<r>{0}</r>这些人不顺眼了，居然还敢向我宗宣战。今日我定要杀个痛快！

5140246.en: Alas! I want to fight alongside my brethren so much to repel the invasion.
5140246.ch: 唉！真是苦恼，我也想与同门弟子们一齐战斗，抵御攻击。

5140252.en: Well done, everyone! The war is not over yet. Please follow me to the inner battlefield to assist the other Disciples.
5140252.ch: 各位辛苦了！接下来还有战斗，请随我前往内部战场帮助其他弟子战斗。

5140255.en: <r>{0}</r> has slain the Guardian, and the seal is broken. They'll break into the main palace soon! I will join the battle myself and slay {name|B}. Disciples, prepare for battle!
5140255.ch: <r>{0}</r>已经击杀神兽，禁制已经失效，他们马上就会攻入主殿！本宗主将亲自击杀{name|B}，各位弟子请做好迎战的准备！

5140256.en: The Guardian has been slain, and the seal is broken. <r>{0}</r> will break into the main palace soon! Disciples, prepare for battle! Our Sect Leader {name|A} will join the battle and fight the enemy Sect Leader! The victory will be ours!
5140256.ch: 神兽倒下，禁制失效，<r>{0}</r>马上就会攻入主殿！各位弟子速速准备迎敌！至于对方宗主，自有我宗主大人{name|A}亲自迎战，诸位不必惊慌。

5140258.en: We <r>{1}</r> will never fall! {name|C}, I will fight you to death!
5140258.ch: 我<r>{1}</r>必不会败！{name|C}，我要与你一决死战！

5140259.en: Follow my orders, Disciples! Give it your all to repel enemy attack and protect our <r>{1}</r>!
5140259.ch: 全体弟子听令，诸位弟子请用尽全力抵抗攻击，保住我<r>{1}</r>！

5140281.en: All Disciples and Initiates, follow my orders! Suppress the enemy Sect Array, defend the breach, occupy the Array Core, weaken its defense, and deny it of recovery!
5140281.ch: 内门外门弟子听令！压制敌方宗门大阵，死守缺口，占据阵眼，削弱其防护之力，不得让其恢复！

5140283.en: True Disciples and all Elders, follow my orders! Follow me into the enemy Sect Array, find their Sect Guardian and slay it at once!
5140283.ch: 真传弟子及全体长老听令！随本宗主深入敌方宗门大阵，直取其护宗神兽，务必迅速将其斩杀，不得有误！

5140285.en: All Disciples and Initiates, follow my orders! Defend our Sect Array at all costs, protect the Array Core, and hold up until our sect array recovers!
5140285.ch: 内门外门弟子听令！拼死守住宗门大阵，保护阵眼，务必撑到宗门大阵恢复！

5140287.en: True Disciples and all Elders, follow my orders! Follow me and our Sect Guardian to repel the invaders in our Sect Array! Those that do not belong here belong to the hell!
5140287.ch: 真传弟子及全体长老听令！随本宗主与护宗神兽，杀退进入宗门大阵的敌方众人，非我宗门者，尽数诛绝！

5140301.en: {callSchool|A}, our Sect has destroyed the enemy Sect's Guardian. Their Sect Leader has nowhere left to turn. He's up ahead, on top of the cliff.
5140301.ch: {callSchool|A}，我宗众人已将敌方宗门的神兽击杀，此刻敌方宗主已无路可逃，就在前方的山崖之上。

5140302.en: {callSchool|A}, this cave belongs to a hostile Sect and only Sect Leaders may enter. Any who fall inside cannot be healed. Still, although we might not be able to help you directly, we can use Secret Sect Techniques to concentrate energy in your body and help you out.
5140302.ch: {callSchool|A}，此处乃敌方宗门洞天，只有身为宗主之人方可进入，若陨落于其中便无法得到救治。然而，我等众人虽不能直接施以援手，却可以通过宗门秘法将灵力汇聚于宗主您的体内，助您一臂之力。

5140303.en: The power of Sect Tradition, with enhanced stats
5140303.ch: 宗门传承之力，属性增强

5140306.en: {callSchool|A}, our sect has emerged victorious in battle after battle, and the enemy sect has been routed. {callSchool|A}, what are we going to do with them?
5140306.ch: {callSchool|A}，我宗连战连胜，所向披靡，已然将敌方宗门完全击溃，请问{callSchool|A}要如何处置对方？

5140307.en: {callSchool|A}, our Sect has repelled enemy attack with our joint forces. They have fled for their lives and left behind many resources. Let's send our Disciples to clear the battlefield for some loot.
5140307.ch: {callSchool|A}。我宗上下齐心合力，已然粉碎了敌方的攻势。如今这些鼠辈悻然离去，倒遗留了不少资源，且让弟子打扫战场，一定会有所收获。

5140308.en: {callSchool|A}, the enemy is too strong to be trifled with. Our attack has bogged down, dropping us in disadvantage. We'd better give the enemy some resources as compensation and retreat as soon as possible.
5140308.ch: {callSchool|A}，敌方实力强劲、不容小觑，眼下我宗攻势受阻，情况不利，还是赔偿对方一定资源，尽早抽身撤退为好。

5140309.en: {callSchool|A}, the enemy is so cunning and cruel. Our defense has been crushed, and we can't hold them back any more. It pains me to admit that our sect is losing this war.
5140309.ch: {callSchool|A}，敌方诡计多端、下手狠辣，眼下我宗防线溃散、难以抵敌。纵使心中万分不愿，我也必须承认我宗败局已定。

5140310.en: {callSchool|A}, our sect broke through enemy ranks and saved our ally sect from annihilation.
5140310.ch: {callSchool|A}，我宗无人可挡，气势如虹，成功支援了友方宗门，保全了其多年基业。

5140311.en: {callSchool|A}, the enemy is too strong to be trifled with. Our reinforcements were blocked, and we failed to save our ally sect.
5140311.ch: {callSchool|A}，敌方实力强劲、不容小觑，我宗遭遇挫折、陷入窘境，遗憾未能保住友方宗门。

5140312.en: Understood! At your order, we are disbanding the enemy sect and making it our branch! Please choose our members to stay in this branch.
5140312.ch: 好！禀宗主之令，将对方宗门从八荒山海中抹去，由此成为我宗的分舵！请宗主挑选留守于该分舵的我宗人员。

5140313.en: Understood! At your order, we are taking all their resources back to our sect!
5140313.ch: 好！禀宗主之令，将对方宗门全部资源尽数带走，返回我方宗门！

5140321.en: The enemy Sect Leader triggered the Sect Tradition before death and obtained enormous power! We must be extremely careful.
5140321.ch: 对方宗主在生命垂危之际，竟然引发宗门传承，获得了异常强大的力量！我等可要加倍小心才是。

5140322.en: This...is the Sect Tradition! With such divine power, you will turn the tide of war!
5140322.ch: 这……竟然是宗门传承！宗主大人有此神力加持，必定能反败为胜！

6000301.en: Would you be willing to become a True Disciple of Recruitment and snare the geniuses of the world?
6000301.ch: 你可愿成为我招贤堂的真传弟子网罗八荒奇才？

6000401.en: Would you be willing to become a True Disciple of Patrol and safeguard the world's law and order?
6000401.ch: 你可愿成为我巡查堂的真传弟子维护八荒法纪？

6000501.en: Would you be willing to become a True Disciple of External Affairs and oversee diplomacy in the world?
6000501.ch: 你可愿成为我外务堂的真传弟子纵横八荒？

6000601.en: Would you be willing to become a True Disciple of Herb Garden and help the world?
6000601.ch: 你可愿成为我药石园的真传弟子济世八荒？

6000701.en: Would you be willing to become a True Disciple of Spirit Vein Cavern and enter the traditional world?
6000701.ch: 你可愿成为我灵脉洞的真传弟子传承八荒？

6000801.en: Would you be willing to become my True Disciple and behold the world?
6000801.ch: 你可愿成为我的真传弟子一览八荒？

6000901.en: Would you be willing to become my True Disciple and travel freely around the world?
6000901.ch: 你可愿成为我的真传弟子逍遥八荒？

6001301.en: I was right about you. This is my promotion gift for you, so take it. After you become a True Disciple, remember to be disciplined and continue to work hard on your cultivation.
6001301.ch: 为师果然没有看错你，这是我为你准备的晋升之礼，你且收下。成为真传弟子以后切记不可顽劣，要继续努力修行。

6001401.en: Your qualifications are impressive. I hope you continue to work more on your cultivation after you become my Last Disciple. Take this as a gift to my disciple to congratulate the promotion.
6001401.ch: 你资质不俗，成为我的关门弟子后望更加努力修行，这份礼物就算我给徒儿的晋升贺礼吧。

6002701.en: The new generation is formidable. It seems it's time for me to step aside...
6002701.ch: 后生可畏，看来我也该退位让贤了…

6002901.en: You cannot yet become an Elder with your current cultivation level.
6002901.ch: 以你目前的修为还无法担当长老一职。

6003001.en: You want to replace me with your cultivation level? Ridiculous!
6003001.ch: 以你的修为竟然还想取代我？可笑！

6003301.en: You cannot yet become a Grand Elder with your current cultivation level.
6003301.ch: 以你目前的修为还无法担当大长老一职。

6004001.en: {school|A} disciples are said to be honest and are widely respected... and today I have a chance to be of assistance. I, {name|B}, feel duty bound to help!
6004001.ch: 在下素闻{school|A}门人个个光明磊落、大义凛然，乃八荒中人人敬仰的俊才，今日既有机会施以援手，我{name|B}义不容辞！

6004101.en: Ha! {school|A} disciples are said to be cruel and unscrupulous. Now that I have encountered some, I cannot stand idly by. Take this!
6004101.ch: 哼哼，传闻{school|A}上下尽是些狼心狗肺、十恶不赦之徒，如今既被我撞见，在下岂能袖手旁观，看招！

6004201.en: Who is it that has the audacity to touch the people of {school|C}? I will say it plainly. If you insist on moving against us, you will be an enemy of the major Sects of the world. There will be no place to bury your body if you provoke our ire!
6004201.ch: 何人如此大胆，竟敢擅动{school|C}之人！我丑话说在前头，你若执意动手，便是与八荒名门为敌，到时惹火上身，可是死无葬身之地！

6004301.en: Hahaha! The people of {school|C} are really the rats everyone shouts at. Since I'm fighting others here, I should do the right thing and destroy this inferior generation right here and now!
6004301.ch: 哈哈哈，{school|C}之人果然是人人喊打的过街之鼠，既然在此与他人争斗，在下自当一同替天行道，将此猪狗不如之辈斩杀当场！

6004401.en: Cough, cough... My cultivation is shallow and I am simply lack the strength to lend help. I am sure the people of {school|A} are able to turn misfortunes into blessings, and find the silver lining. I shall first take my leave!
6004401.ch: 咳咳……在下修为浅薄，实在无力相助，想必{school|A}之人定能逢凶化吉、遇难成祥，在下先行告辞！

6005001.en: The scene in front of me makes me somehow sentimental.
6005001.ch: 此情此景，在下不禁心绪万千。

6005002.en: On the path of cultivation, our Sect is truly fortunate to have such a development.
6005002.ch: 仙途茫茫，我宗有此进益，吾心甚慰。

6005003.en: To celebrate the relocation of the Sect, I shall write a poem...
6005003.ch: 我宗喜得乔迁，某当赋诗一首以为祝贺……

6005004.en: The road ahead is long. We must be fearless and make our Sect proud.
6005004.ch: 前路漫漫，我辈当上下求索，不负宗门之意。

6005005.en: How shall this journey end? My trigrams have the answer...
6005005.ch: 此去是吉是凶，待某卜上一卦……

6005006.en: The Sect is thriving. Looks like I really am fortunate.
6005006.ch: 宗门如此兴盛，看来我果真是有福之人。

6005007.en: May the journey be smooth, without any unexpected occurrences.
6005007.ch: 但愿这趟平安无事，莫要横生枝节。

6005008.en: This Flying Canoe sure is magical. Wonder if I'll ever get my hands on one.
6005008.ch: 这飞舟着实奇妙，不知我有生之年能否搞上一艘……

6005009.en: I've been excited to leave for a while, but now that it's time, I can't help feeling a bit melancholy.
6005009.ch: 虽早就迫不及待，但当真离开这片土地之时，我心中竟也略感惆怅。

6005010.en: I hope my cultivation level can advance as soon as possible. I don't want to fall behind!
6005010.ch: 唔，希望我的修为也要早日进步，千万不可落下了。

6005011.en: Wonder what will happen in the next Zhou.
6005011.ch: 不知在下个州又会发生怎样的事……

6005012.en: The path of cultivation becomes increasingly perilous as it goes on. More challenges must await on this journey.
6005012.ch: 修仙之路每进一步便凶险一分，此去只怕要面临更严峻的考验。

6005013.en: Our Sect has just relocated today. It should be a joyful occasion.
6005013.ch: 今日我宗乔迁之喜，总该开心些才是。

6005014.en: There may be some obstacles on the way, but they're mere small hindrances to me.
6005014.ch: 这一路上或许有些阻挠，但在我看来也不过是些小风小浪罢了。

6005015.en: I'm not even sure if my cultivation level would help me enough at my destination.
6005015.ch: 也不知我的修为能否在将去之处立足。

6005016.en: The relocation of the Sect is truly a once-in-a-hundred-years event. Really didn't expect it to happen in my lifetime!
6005016.ch: 宗门搬迁实乃百年难遇之事，没想到竟被我赶上了！

6005017.en: Ha! A majestic canoe like this... Our Sect must be the only one in these lands fortunate enough to ride it!
6005017.ch: 哈哈哈，这等雄奇之舟，除了我宗之外，恐怕放眼八荒也无几人有福乘坐。

6005018.en: Standing high up on the canoe and gazing down at the lands afar, it feels like I could just reach up and touch the sky.
6005018.ch: 伫立舟上，居高望远，仿佛天道触手可及。

6005019.en: The scenes depicted in the artwork, Sketch of Life, really makes one think.
6005019.ch: 看八荒众生图景，倒叫人有所明悟。

6005020.en: I don't think the Sect relocation will go smoothly. We must remain vigilant.
6005020.ch: 此次宗门搬迁，想必不会太平，我等不可放松警惕。

6005021.en: Those sightless fools had better not mess with our plans.
6005021.ch: 希望不会有那等不开眼之辈来坏我等的心情。

6005022.en: Our Sect is finally relocating! A rare occasion indeed!
6005022.ch: 今日我宗终得乔迁，不易，不易，哈哈哈！

6005023.en: My friends, the whole world will remember the name of our Sect one day!
6005023.ch: 诸位，早晚有一天，八荒会记住我宗的大名。

6005024.en: Come, let's have a drink on the Flying Canoe. Here's to another thousand years of prosperity for our Sect!
6005024.ch: 来来来，我等于飞舟之上畅饮一杯，祝我宗传代千年！

6005025.en: For our relocation to be successful, countless hardships shall be endured—as is the way of cultivation.
6005025.ch: 此番迁移，便如同修仙之道，唯有去无回、置之死地而后生耳……

6100101.en: You've signed up for Sect Tryouts. Please return to the Sect at the beginning of next month for the duel.
6100101.ch: 你已成功报名入门小比，请于下月初准时回到宗门参加比试。

6100201.en: Looks like you're the only one who signed up for the duel, so you're automatically the victor. Congratulations!
6100201.ch: 貌似只有你1人报名了本次宗门小比呢…恭喜你，直接获得胜利！

6100301.en: Start this Promotion Duel (Sect Tryouts) now?
6100301.ch: 是否现在就开始本届入门小比？

6100401.en: Congratulations on your victory. You're officially an Initiate of our Sect now!
6100401.ch: 恭喜获胜。自今日起你正式成为本宗外门弟子！

6100501.en: Too bad, you lost in the Sect Duel. Never mind. Keep up the hard work!
6100501.ch: 很遗憾，你在本次宗门小比中不幸落败……不要气馁，再接再厉！

6100601.en: You've signed up for Promotion Duel (Disciple). Please return to the Sect at the beginning of next month for the duel.
6100601.ch: 你已成功报名外门小比，请于下月初准时回到宗门参加比试。

6100801.ch: 是否现在就开始本届外门小比？

6100901.en: Congratulations! You're now officially a Disciple of our Sect!
6100901.ch: 恭喜，自今日起你正式成为本宗内门弟子！

6101001.en: Too bad, you lost in the Sect Duel. Keep working hard and victory will be yours one day!
6101001.ch: 很遗憾，你在本次宗门小比中不幸落败……不要气馁，失败乃成功之母。

6101101.en: You've signed up for Promotion Duel (True Disciple). Please return to the Sect at the beginning of next month for the duel.
6101101.ch: 你已成功报名内门小比，请于下月初准时回到宗门参加比试。

6101301.en: Start this Promotion Duel (True Disciple) now?
6101301.ch: 是否现在就开始本届内门小比？

6101401.en: You've advanced to the next round, and you're now qualified to challenge the True Disciples in the Sect!
6101401.ch: 你晋级了下一轮，获得挑战本宗真传弟子资格！

6101501.en: Too bad, you lost the Sect Duel (Elder).
6101501.ch: 很遗憾，你未能在与真传弟子的比试中胜出。

6101601.en: This stubborn, wretched person doesn't deserve to be a True Disciple in the Sect.
6101601.ch: 此人顽劣至极，不配做本宗真传弟子！

6101602.en: You want to become a True Disciple in our Sect? Dream on!
6101602.ch: 哼，想成为本宗的真传弟子么？痴心妄想！

6101701.en: We have an empty slot, so congratulations! You're now a True Disciple of the Elder!
6101701.ch: 席位尚有空缺，恭喜你成为该长老门下的真传弟子！

6101801.en: From this day forth you must uphold the Sect law, stay true to your purpose, cultivate your mind and demonstrate the heart of Tao.
6101801.ch: 入我门下，也算你造化不浅。从今日起，你需恪守门规，谨记宗旨，勤修不辍，以证道心。

6101901.en: Looks like I won. You should go back and train for a while before coming back.
6101901.ch: 看来是我赢了，你还是回去再修炼一段时间再来吧。

6102001.en: The new generation is formidable... but I'm no easy target either!
6102001.ch: 真的是后生可畏啊~但我也不是那么好对付的！

6102002.en: I worked hard to become a True Disciple. I'm not giving up my slot without a fight!
6102002.ch: 辛苦得来的真传弟子之位，岂能让之？！

6102003.en: I've heard a lot about you... but I didn't expect you to be here, dueling me for the True Disciple position. Well, then, show me what you've got!
6102003.ch: 我听说过你的事迹，想不到今天竟会来此与我争夺真传弟子席位…来吧，请赐教！

6102004.en: You really think you can become a True Disciple with your current cultivation level? I'll teach you a lesson!
6102004.ch: 本宗真传弟子非尔等之流所能企及，今天就让你见识见识我的厉害！

6102101.en: From now on, you're my True Disciple. I should warn you—I can be harsh.
6102101.ch: 今日起你就是本长老门下的真传弟子了，做好心理准备，我的修行可是很严格的。

6102201.en: Elders occupy a high office in this Sect. They are responsible for the education of Disciples and are a force to be reckoned with. You have signed up for the Promotion Duel (Grand Elder) and will take on the Elder and all their True Disciples at the allotted time. Make sure you are ready and come back in 1 month to fight in the Duel!
6102201.ch: 长老乃本宗要职，负责教化弟子，其实力更是不容小觑。你已报名真传比试，届时将对战长老及其所有真传弟子，请做好充足的准备，1个月后回来比试吧！

6102301.ch: 是否现在就开始本届真传大比？

6102401.en: There's no need for the esteemed Master to duel this kid himself. I'll handle it in a flash!
6102401.ch: 对付这种货色，不必劳烦尊师出手，看我三两下解决了此人！！

6102402.en: You really think you can replace Master as Elder... with those skills? Over my dead body!
6102402.ch: 就凭你也妄图撼动师父的长老之位？！先过了我这关再说！！！

6102501.en: Ha, you gotta train for another 10 years!
6102501.ch: 哈，不自量力！回去修炼个十年再来吧！

6102601.en: You must be quite skilled to have arrived here. Show me what you've got!
6102601.ch: 足下既然能来到此处，想必是身手了得。就让我先来领教一二！

6102602.en: Master has always been generous. Now, I want you to prove your worthiness to me!
6102602.ch: 师父他老人家向来心胸宽广、海纳百川，但我也要先试试看你有没有这个资格！

6102701.en: Thanks for the match. I've won... by the skin of my teeth! Don't be discouraged. Train well and come challenge me again!
6102701.ch: 承让！看来是我略胜一筹，足下不必气馁，回去修炼一番再来挑战吧。

6102801.en: It's true that the new generation will have to replace the old eventually... but I won't let that happen so soon!
6102801.ch: 虽说是长江后浪推前浪，但我可不会轻易让出这长老之位！

6102802.en: Huge responsibility comes with being an Elder. Since you dare challenge me, you must be quite determined. Well, then, don't blame me for what I'm about to do to you!
6102802.ch: 长老之职事关重大，你既有胆向我发起挑战，定是做好了相当觉悟，那就莫怪我让你尝些苦头了！

6102901.en: Ha! You are no match for me, milk-drinker! Get outta my sight!!!
6102901.ch: 哼！乳臭未干的小子竟妄想于我为敌，还不速速退下！！

6103001.en: Wait! I'd like to see how this young one's skills measure up. Let me duel you instead!
6103001.ch: 且慢！本场比试就暂由老夫代比吧，容我来试试这年轻人的身手！

6103101.en: The path of cultivation is long—so no need to be rueful over such an insignificant loss. You'll achieve greater breakthroughs later!
6103101.ch: 路漫漫其修远兮，无需计较一时之得失。今日你虽败于老夫之手，但假以时日定能取得更大突破。

6103201.en: I never thought you would be the one to take my Elder position...
6103201.ch: 没想到抢走我长老之位的人竟然是你…

6103301.en: Very well, very well. You really were taught well. You'll fit the Elder role of our Sect perfectly. We're truly fortunate to have you!
6103301.ch: 嗯—不错不错，孺子可教也。本宗能得小友出任长老之职，也可谓一大幸事啊！

6103401.en: Congratulations! You're the Sect Elder from now on. Be a good role model for your apprentices!
6103401.ch: 恭喜你！今后你就是本宗长老了，要好好教徒弟哦~

6103501.en: Unfortunately you did not win... but your opponent was the Elder, after all! No need to be discouraged. Keep up the hard work!
6103501.ch: 很遗憾，你未能取胜…但对手毕竟是长老嘛，别泄气！继续努力！

6103601.en: Promotion Duel (Grand Elder) is no walk in the park. Please prepare to the best of your ability before returning to the Sect for the duel next month. Everyone's cheering you on!
6103601.ch: 长老大比非同小可，还请务必做好完全准备，下月回到宗门准时参加比试，加油！

6103701.en: Start this Promotion Duel (Grand Elder) now?
6103701.ch: 是否现在就开始本届长老大比？

6103801.en: I've defeated countless Disciples dreaming of replacing me as Grand Elder. You gotta show me what sets you apart from them.
6103801.ch: 本座曾经击败无数像你一样觊觎大长老之位的弟子，今天我倒想看看你与他们有何不同？！

6103901.en: Get outta here! You're no match for me!
6103901.ch: 退下吧，你不是我的对手！！

6104101.en: With adequate training, even the weakest can become a contender. However, you're still a bit inexperienced compared to me. I won.
6104101.ch: 千锤百炼，淬火成钢！或许小友还是略显稚嫩，今天是老夫赢了。

6104201.en: Ha, what a match! You're the Sect's new Grand Elder...
6104201.ch: 罢了罢了，今日起你就是本宗大长老了…

6104301.en: Haha, that was exhilarating! With all my years of cultivation, I couldn't defeat you, my friend. From now on, you're the Grand Elder of the Sect!
6104301.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，痛快！纵使老夫修炼多年，也不敌小友这般身手。今日起你就是本宗大长老了！！

6104401.en: One day you are cultivating as usual, when you notice light flickering on the horizon. An instant later, the shifting body of light is standing by your side. When your eyes adjust, you see your visitor is in fact the Sect Leader.
6104401.ch: 这天，你如往常般修行，只见天边一道流光闪烁，转眼就来到了你的身边。你定睛观看，来者正是我宗宗主。

6104501.en: When I first saw you, {call|B|A}, I knew you were no ordinary disciple. Since joining, you have worked day and night and made a significant contribution to the Sect. You have traveled far and brought glory to our name. You continue the legacy of our founder, and I am most grateful.
6104501.ch: {call|B|A}，初见之时，我便知你并非池中之物。入宗以来，你不仅为宗门日夜操劳、积攒贡献，更是行走八荒，为我宗扬名，如此种种，颇有初代宗主遗风，我深感欣慰。

6104601.en: It has been playing on my mind lately—you are better suited to the position of {school|A} Sect Leader than me. I am therefore willing step aside, for the greater glory of the Sect.
6104601.ch: 我近日夜有所思，这{school|A}宗主之位，若由你来担当，似乎胜过在下颇多。为了让我宗日后登临八荒绝顶，我理当让贤。

6104701.en: Suddenly, I sense a vacancy in the Sect hierarchy. The Sect Tradition trials have begun. I sense the legacy of the founder is with me and approves of my decision. Go forth, challenge the Tradition and take up your rightful place as Sect Leader!
6104701.ch: 恰在此时，我感受到宗门职位晋升的尽头悄然打开，宗门传承试炼再度开启，想必是初代宗主的遗志与我相合，认同我的决定。还望你当仁不让，前去挑战传承，继任宗主之位！

6104801.en: If you pass the Tradition's trial, I will serve you will all my heart, and work for the glory of {school|A}!
6104801.ch: 若你能在职位晋升的尽头通过传承考验，我便会一心一意辅佐于你，任凭你差遣，共成我{school|A}之霸业！

6104901.en: One day you get the sense that a divine presence in the mountains behind the Sect has turned its dispassionate attention upon you.
6104901.ch: 某天，你突然冥冥中感到，后山隐秘之处，一道神念正若有若无地关注着你。

6105001.en: The divine presence is sublime and pure and shares a mystical connection with the Sect Leader's aura. You're only aware of it because it wishes you to know of its existence.
6105001.ch: 这股神念精纯无比，与宗主身上散发的气息有着某种共通之妙。你能肯定，它的存在，是它故意让你探查而知的。

6105101.en: "Come to the mountain behind the Sect..." A quiet, low voice echoes inside your mind. The mists disperse and a pathway opens up, leading into the mountains.
6105101.ch: “到后山来……”一声古朴的低吟回荡在你脑海，后山隐秘之处的云雾悄然散去，一条道路出现在你的面前。

6105191.en: (You have found the Sect Tradition. You may challenge it via Position Promotion.)
6105191.ch: （现在你已经找到了宗门传承，可以通过职位晋升通道挑战宗门传承）

6105201.en: "The Sect I entrust to thee..." One day you are sitting in meditation when you hear the Sect Leader's voice, though he is nowhere to be seen. Inexplicably a vision of a place where Qi energy converges in the mountains behind the Sect appears in your mind...
6105201.ch: “宗门就托付给此人……”某天打坐修行中，你的脑海中突然响起宗主的声音，紧接着，宗门后山中一处灵气翻涌之地莫名出现在你的脑海……

6105301.en: You're moving towards the altar when a shadow appears in front of you.
6105301.ch: 你刚刚靠近祭坛，一道虚影出现在了你的面前。

6105401.en: The shadow, exuding a powerful aura, draws close to you.
6105401.ch: 虚影身上散发出一股强大的力量，向你靠近过来。

6105501.en: As the mirage dissipates, you're enveloped by a bright light.
6105501.ch: 随着残像的消散，一道光芒笼罩了你。

6105601.en: When the light fades away, you find yourself standing in front of the altar, and the inscriptions on it have clearly changed. Under the title "Sect Leader", your name has appeared.
6105601.ch: 光芒消失时你发现自己站在祭坛前，祭坛上的文字明显发生了变化，在宗主之位上出现了你的名字。

6105701.en: You're no match for the shadow. Suddenly, a bright beam of light shines down on you and the shadow disappears, as if nothing had even happened.
6105701.ch: 你不敌虚影，一道光闪过以后，虚影消失，好像什么都没有发生过一样。

6105801.en: You sigh and make your way out of the chamber.
6105801.ch: 你叹了口气，悄悄离开了祭坛。

6105901.en: Hahahaha! How my heart sings! Now I can leave the Sect in your capable hands.
6105901.ch: 哈哈哈哈！吾心甚慰，如此，我便能放心地把宗门托付给你了。

6106001.en: Much work remains to be done and only Heaven-chosen like you can do it. The hopes of the Sect now rest on your shoulders!
6106001.ch: 宗主一职任重而道远，也只有你这等天骄之人方可胜任。宗门未来的希望就都在你身上了！

6106101.en: I have collected many items over the years. I leave them all to you. Use them well, for the glory of the Sect!
6106101.ch: 此处有我多年所藏之物，今日便一同赠予你，以助我宗门发展壮大！

6106201.en: You carry on the belief of the previous Sect Leader and become the new Sect Leader of {0}.
6106201.ch: 你继承前任宗主的壮志，成为{0}新的宗主！

6106301.en: You've earned approval of the Sect Tradition and become the new {school|A} Sect Leader.
6106301.ch: 你获得传承的认可，成为{school|A}新的宗主。

6106401.en: {name|B} feels frustrated but has no alternative. After all, the Sect Tradition has chosen someone else, indicating the founder had someone else in mind.
6106401.ch: {name|B}虽然心有不甘，却也无可奈何，毕竟宗门传承选择他人，便意味着初代宗主的遗志另有所选。

6106501.en: Several days later, a great ceremony is held in {school|A} to celebrate your elevation to the position of Sect Leader.
6106501.ch: 数日后，{school|A}举行了盛大隆重的大典，庆贺你荣登宗主之位。

6106701.en: The Sect Leader has passed away. The position goes to you, as a matter of course, without any objections.
6106701.ch: 前任宗主已然仙逝，宗主之位顺延到你的身上，也是人心所向、大势所趋。

6106901.en: This True Disciple cannot be deployed. The duel is supposed to show me how you can fight!
6106901.ch: 该真传弟子无法出战。这场比试就由我来看看你的实力吧！

6107201.en:
Despite the demanding sect rules, we have our characteristics:
{0}, {1}.
6107201.ch:
虽然门规多有限制，但我宗也有自己的特点：
{0}、{1}。

6107301.en: Please abide by the rules and focus on cultivation.
6107301.ch: 希望你能恪守门规，勤加修炼。

6107401.en: {name|A} has blended Heavenly Power in an attempt to break through to Transcendent Realm, but the law of nature will annihilate anyone with such an attempt.
6107401.ch: {name|A}融合仙力意欲登仙，八荒山海的天地法则将对其进行抹杀。

6111001.en: The position of {0} in our sect is vacant for the moment. To stabilize sect development, we'd like to promote an elite to the position of {0}. We hereby appoint you as deputy {0} to manage sect affairs.
6111001.ch: 由于我宗{0}之位空缺，为了宗门的发展，推选本宗精英临时担任{0}一职，现任命你为代理{0}，管理宗门事务。

6111101.en: {callSchool|A}, you can be promoted to {0} at best in this branch.

6111102.en: To get promoted to a higher position, you need to head to the branch in the next region or the headquarters.
6111102.ch: 想要晋升更高职位可前往下一区域的分舵或总舵。

6111201.en: {callSchool|A}, I rushed here after hearing your wish to leave the sect. {callSchool|A}, is it because you want to go to the next region?
6111201.ch: {callSchool|A}，听说你打算退出宗门我就赶过来了，请问{callSchool|A}是否是因为要去往下一个区域才选择退宗？

6111202.en: {callSchool|A}, don't worry. When you reach {0} Realm and arrive in {1}, the sect will issue a pass to you so that you can join the superior branch or headquarters of our sect.
6111202.ch: {callSchool|A}请勿担心，当你达到{0}境到达{1}时宗门会发放通行证方便你加入本宗上级分舵或总舵的。

6111203.en: {callSchool|A}, if you long to be a Rogue Cultivator, I won't stop you. {callSchool|A}, I wish you a happy and fulfilling life.
6111203.ch: 如果{callSchool|A}确实向往散修的生活，我也不便继续挽留，只能祝愿{callSchool|A}早日找到自己向往的仙途。

6111301.en: I have left {0}, and I don't have a plan to join {1} for the moment.
6111301.ch: 我已经离开了{0},短时间内没有加入{1}的打算。

6111401.en: {callSchool|A}, do you know the Sect Guardian is capable of Spirit Transformation? Give it some Spiritual Fruits, and it will turn them into a Spiritual Fruit you want! Take these and try it out!
6111401.ch: {callSchool|A}，你可知道宗门神兽有化灵的能力，给与数个灵果能化为一个你想要的灵果！这里有几个灵果{callSchool|A}拿去试试吧。

6111402.en: You learned very quickly, {callSchool|A}. Here are some more Spiritual Fruits for you.
6111402.ch: 不愧是{callSchool|A}一学就会，这里还有几个灵果也一起送给{callSchool|A}吧。

6121101.en: I hear a strange sound nearby, as if somebody is working covertly.
6121101.ch: 附近隐有异响，似是什么人在暗中行事。

6121201.en: The moon is bright and the stars are few in this desolate area. Two black-robed men are facing each other, the atmosphere grows tense.
6121201.ch: 月明星稀，荒郊野外，两个黑袍人彼此对立，场面剑拔弩张。

6121501.en: You can only blame your poor fortune to fall in my hands today. If you have no last words to say, then I will send you on your way!
6121501.ch: 妖道，今日落入我的手中，只能怪你福薄命浅。若无甚遗言要讲，我这就送你上路！

6121601.en: Hmph, {heresyName|B} is going to kill all of {heresyName|C} sooner or later!
6121601.ch: 哼，我{heresyName|B}早晚将你{heresyName|C}这些十恶不赦之人斩尽杀绝！

6121701.en: Still acting tough even in the jaws of death huh, in that case...
6121701.ch: 死到临头还敢嘴硬，那好……

6121901.en: Who's hiding in the shadows, show yourself!
6121901.ch: 什么人躲在暗处，还不速速现身！

6122001.en: Beware, this person is sinister and ruthless and should not be taken lightly. If you are not fully confident, do not take part in this matter and leave immediately for good!
6122001.ch: 道友当心，此人阴险毒辣、不可轻敌，若道友没有十足把握，不必插手此事，还是立刻离去为好！

6122101.en: What should be done in a situation like this?

6122301.en: How interesting, to think that you would want to save this person. It seems like you are {heresyName|B}'s accomplice so don't blame me for what happens next. Take this!
6122301.ch: 有趣，竟然想搭救此人，看来你也是此人{heresyName|B}的同党，那在下可就不客气了，接招！

6122401.en: I'm not afraid to tell you that I'm backed by {heresyName|C}! If you know what to do and let me go I'll pretend nothing ever happened, otherwise...
6122401.ch: 不怕告诉你，我背后可是{heresyName|C}！你若识时务，将我放过，我就当此事没发生过，如若不然……

6122501.en: My friend, this is an extremely vile person who implanted a heart parasite in my body. If we don't kill him and cut off the caster who implanted it, I don't think I will be able to survive.
6122501.ch: 道友，此人阴毒异常，先前便在我体内种下了夺命摄心蛊，若不将此人杀死、斩断施蛊之人，则恐怕我也难以幸存。

6122601.en: As expected from a genius of this era, you know your place. Doing this will be good for you too. Farewell!
6122601.ch: 阁下如此有眼色，不愧是当世英才。这么做对你也有好处，告辞！

6122701.en: Cough... My life... was not lived in vain... This jade plaque... is my Taoist Mind Pavilion token... Take it... Ugh...
6122701.ch: 咳咳……我这一生……总算没白活……这块玉牌……乃我道心阁信物……你且拿去……噗……

6122801.en: Do you really not fear revenge from {heresyName|C}? Arrrrghhhhh!
6122801.ch: 你就当真不怕我{heresyName|C}的报复吗，啊啊啊啊！

6122901.en: You saved my life and I will never forget your kindness. This jade plaque is a token of the Taoist Mind Pavilion and of extraordinary value. I shall gift it to you as a memento... Let us meet again!
6122901.ch: 你的救命之恩，我永世难忘，这块玉牌乃我道心阁信物，价值非凡，赠予阁下留作纪念……后会有期！

6123101.en: Hahaha, the people of the {heresyName|B} are a bunch of complete pushovers, can't even take a single strike.
6123101.ch: 哈哈哈，{heresyName|B}的人果然都是一群废物，如此不堪一击。

6123201.en: I'll send you both on your way together, so that you may have a companion in hell. Die!
6123201.ch: 我这就送你们一同上路，好让你们黄泉之下也有个伴，去死吧！

6123301.en: It's my fault for dragging you into this. If there is an afterlife, I will definitely repay this debt.
6123301.ch: 是我连累了道友，若有来生，在下再偿还此番亏欠……

6123501.en: How could it be...you...I'll spare your life this time, but don't ever get involved in our affairs again. Get lost!
6123501.ch: 怎么会…你…这次饶你一命，下次不要再掺和我们的事情。还不快走…

6123701.en: Perhaps the night winds were too strong so I heard wrong. There wasn't anyone else present.
6123701.ch: 许是夜风太大，我听错了，根本没有他人在场……

6123801.en: How dare you try to deceive me, die!
6123801.ch: 好你个妖道，竟然还想蒙蔽于我，受死！

6124101.en: Hmph, ending this person's life would count as an achievement for {heresyName|C}. We shouldn't stay here for long, retreat!
6124101.ch: 哼，了结此人，也算为我{heresyName|C}立下功劳一件，此地不宜久留，撤！

6124301.en: Still want to run? Are you afraid that {heresyName|B}'s accomplices may have cowered at the sight of me? Take this!
6124301.ch: 还想跑？怕不是{heresyName|B}的同伙，看到在下后心生胆怯？接招！

6124401.en: You demon! How dare you try to deceive me, die!
6124401.ch: 好你个妖人，竟然还想蒙蔽于我，受死！

6131301.en: To fall in my hands today, you can only blame your poor fortune. If you have no last words to say, then I will send you on your way!
6131301.ch: 妖道，今日落入我的手中，只能怪你福薄命浅。若无甚遗言要讲，我这就送你上路！

6132201.en: If you want to kill or cut me, you're free to do so. But let me remind you that I am backed by {heresyName|C}, so you should think carefully!
6132201.ch: 要杀要剐你尽管随意，不过别怪我没提醒你，我背后可是{heresyName|C}，你可要考虑清楚！

6132301.en: This person is a heinous criminal, if there's a chance we should nip the problem in the bud. We must not let him roam free....
6132301.ch: 此人罪大恶极，若有此机会，应当斩草除根，绝不错放才是……

6132501.en: If you let the tiger return to the mountain, it will cause a great disaster... However, this does not concern you. This jade plaque is a token of the Taoist Mind Pavilion's sincerity. Thank you for your help. Goodbye!
6132501.ch: 放虎归山，必酿大祸……然而此事本与阁下无关，这块玉牌乃我道心阁一份心意，多谢阁下出手相助，告辞！

6132701.en: No. no. do not listen to this person's delusion. The people of {heresyName|B} will dispose of the remnants. This jade plaque is a token of the Taoist Mind Pavilion and of extraordinary value. I shall gift it to you as a memento... Let us meet again!
6132701.ch: 快哉快哉，阁下勿听此人妄语，我{heresyName|B}之人自会处置其残党余孽。这块玉牌乃我道心阁信物，价值非凡，赠予阁下留作纪念……后会有期！

6133501.en: Perhaps the night winds were too strong so I heard wrong. There weren't anyone else present.
6133501.ch: 许是夜风太大，我听错了，根本没有他人在场……

6141301.en: You demon! You should be punished for poisoning the Heaven-chosen. Now that you're able to die, what do you have left to say?
6141301.ch: 妖人！你等荼毒天骄、其罪当诛，如今你即将命归九泉之下，还有何话讲？

6141401.en: To be able to give my life for great cause of {heresyName|B} makes it a worthy death.
6141401.ch: 哼，为我{heresyName|B}的大业献出生命，我也算死得其所。

6141501.en: Damn you, you deserve to die. Take this!

6142501.en: If you let the tiger return to the mountain, it will cause a great disaster... However, this does not concern you. This lacquered plaque is a token of the Mindsnap Temple's sincerity. Thank you for your help. Goodbye!
6142501.ch: 放虎归山，必酿大祸……然而此事本与阁下无关，这块漆牌乃我蚀心殿一份心意，多谢阁下出手相助，告辞！

6142701.en: No. no. do not listen to this person's delusion. The people of {heresyName|B} will dispose of the remnants. This lacquered plaque is a token of the Mindsnap Temple and of extraordinary value. I shall gift it to you as a memento... Let us meet again!
6142701.ch: 快哉快哉，阁下勿听此人妄语，我{heresyName|B}之人自会处置其残党余孽。这块漆牌乃我蚀心殿信物，价值非凡，赠予阁下留作纪念……后会有期！

6152201.en: I'm warning you, I am part of {heresyName|C}. This person's currently under my spell. If you dare take my life, I will take him along with me.
6152201.ch: 哼，我可告诉你，在下乃是{heresyName|C}之人，此人被我下了咒法，若你敢伤我性命，则此人也是必死无疑！

6152301.en: You should not worry about my life, just focus on ending this man's life. This vile criminal deserves no chance of life. Dying with him is a good death!
6152301.ch: 无妨，道友切莫顾忌在下之生死，只管了结此人便是，此人罪大恶极，在下与其一同殒命也算死得其所！

6152601.en: Are you really able to bear killing your own companion?
6152601.ch: 你就真忍心亲手杀死你的同党不成？

6153701.en: You weasel! How dare you try to deceive me, die!
6153701.ch: 好你个妖道，竟然还想蒙蔽于我，受死！

6162301.en: You should not worry about my life, just focus on ending this man's life. This vile criminal deserves no chance of life. I have no regret dying with him!
6162301.ch: 无妨，道友切莫顾忌在下之生死，只管了结此人便是，此人罪大恶极，在下与其一同殒命也无憾矣！

6162901.en: Cough... My life... was not lived in vain... This lacquered plaque... is my Mindsnap Temple token... Take it... Ugh...
6162901.ch: 咳咳……我这一生……总算没白活……这块漆牌……乃我蚀心殿信物……你且拿去……噗……

6171101.en: An energy wave has swept over from nearby. It seems as though something is hidden in this place.
6171101.ch: 附近传来灵力波动，似乎此地藏有什么东西。

6171201.en: The moon is bright and the stars are few in this desolate area. Perhaps there is something hidden here.
6171201.ch: 月明星稀，荒郊野外，莫非暗藏一番造化？

6171401.en: You rummage through the corpse's clothes and really was able to find something.
6171401.ch: 你翻找尸体衣物，果真略有收获。

6171501.en: Scoundrel! How dare you harm my companion! You'll pay for that!
6171501.ch: 大胆恶徒，竟敢伤我同仁，纳命来！

6171601.en: Hahaha. That a thief would dare attempt such a thing. You'll pay with your life!
6171601.ch: 哈哈哈，宵小之辈也敢有此图谋，受死！

6171701.en: I don't stand a chance here... Far wiser to leave now.
6171701.ch: ……我不是此人之对手，还是先走为妙。

6171801.en: You closely examine the body and look over the marks. You find a secret letter on the body, and it seems to contain a hard, square-shaped object.
6171801.ch: 你仔细验尸并反复观察周围痕迹，最终在尸体的身下发现了一封密信，其中似乎装着方形硬物。

6172201.en: You find it distasteful to leave a body out in the open, and you dig a hole to bury it in. You feel satisfied for a moment that the right thing has been done.
6172201.ch: 你不忍见人曝尸荒野，便随手挖坑将其掩埋了，一时间心中正气上涌，有所感悟。

6172301.en: Alarmed by the strange circumstances, you leave the body as fast as possible so as not to invite any bad luck.
6172301.ch: 见此人死状诡异，你决定遁走而去，免得沾染了晦气。

6172401.en: This... This is the Taoist Mind Pavilion's seal

6172501.en: You approach the seal and infuse it with energy. It then dissipates like snow in the wind.
6172501.ch: 你走到禁制前将灵力注入其中，禁制便如同积雪融化般消散了。

6172601.en: The monster is now sealed within!

6172701.en: You used Qi to forcibly remove the seal and the hidden objects are now revealed.
6172701.ch: 你用灵气强行破开了禁制，其中藏匿之物显现了出来。

6181001.en: The Elixir you took was so powerful that you didn't remember what happened after you entered the Dangkang Lair. Luckily there was white light on the horizon, signifying the night had passed.
6181001.ch: 服下的丹药效力十分猛烈，你已经不记得深入当康之家后做了什么。好在此时天边泛起鱼肚白，这一晚已经过去了。

6181002.en: You charged into the Wave of Monsters but were mercilessly chased off. You fled in haste, your heart thumping in your chest. This may be the most dangerous experience you have had in life...
6181002.ch: 你深入兽潮，却遭到无情的驱赶。你仓皇逃去，心中突突而跳。生平所遇凶险，或以此为最……

6181003.en: You entered the Dangkang Lair again, and the monsters there were provoked. Fortunately, you fled before they could harm you. But these monsters are attacking the town now, trying to find your whereabouts. It seems that you must solve your troubles with might, or they will solve you in turn.
6181003.ch: 你再次造访当康巢穴，惹得群妖暴怒。而你躲跑及时，妖兽未能对你造成伤害。然而它们为了寻找你的踪迹，正在不停地攻击城镇，看这事态，或已成不死不休之势。

6181004.en: You looked around at the demonic men and were terribly disgusted. Before you could suppress the toxicity of the Hao Qi Elixir, your body had already cast a spell seal at the crowd.
6181004.ch: 你看着周身的魔道中人，不由自主地生出一阵厌恶。还未等你反应过来压制浩气丹的毒性，身体已对人群甩出了一道法印。

6181005.en: The Evil Yuan Elixir suddenly exploded, and before you could react, your body had already gathered Energy to strike at the righteous men around you.
6181005.ch: 邪元丹突然爆发，你还未反应过来，身体已凝聚灵力对周围正道之人出手了。

6181006.en: The demonic men seemed to find out that someone was targeting them and started to search for the culprit.
6181006.ch: 魔道人士似乎察觉到有人对同道之人下手，开始寻找元凶。

6181007.en: The righteous men seemed to find out that someone was targeting them and started to search for the culprit.
6181007.ch: 正道人士似乎察觉到有人对同道之人下手，开始寻找元凶。

6194111.en: {call|B|A}, this is an important territory for our Sect. Go back now.

6194121.en: How dare you break into our {#schoolBuildingName1006}!
6194121.ch: 何人如此大胆！竟敢闯我{#schoolBuildingName1006}！

6194122.en: Who are you to make a scene here?! I'll make you pay.
6194122.ch: 竟敢在此撒野，定要让你付出代价。

6194131.en: {call|B|A}! How dare you break into our {#schoolBuildingName1006}! You're asking for it!

6194132.en: You think you can just come and go here?!
6194132.ch: 这里岂由你说来就来说走就走！

6194133.en: {call|B|A}! How dare you trespass on this important territory for our Sect! You're dead meat!
6194133.ch: {call|B|A}！竟然敢来我宗重地！今日就叫你有来无回！

6194221.en: How dare you break into our {#schoolBuildingName1002}!
6194221.ch: 何人如此大胆！竟敢闯我{#schoolBuildingName1002}！

6194231.en: {call|B|A}! How dare you break into our {#schoolBuildingName1002}! You're asking for it!

6194321.ch: 何人如此大胆！竟敢闯我{#schoolBuildingName1101}！

6194331.en: {call|B|A}! How dare you break into {#schoolBuildingName1101}! You're asking for it!

7001101.en: Follow my orders, Disciples! We must emerge victorious in this Sect Duel. I will accept nothing less!
7001101.ch: 众弟子听令，此番宗门大比，我宗势拔头筹，不得有误！

7001102.en: The treasures of the Dragon Gate are within reach. Everyone must play their part, if the Sect is to achieve riches and glory!
7001102.ch: 龙门秘宝已近在眼前，此行能否振我宗威名、扬我宗风采，就看诸位的表现了！

7001103.en: At the end of the contest Disciples will be rewarded according to their performance. Do your best and win every match!
7001103.ch: 此番大比，全体弟子论功行赏。望诸位竭尽所能，尽力赢得每一场比拼！

7001201.en: We'll keep your advice in mind, {post|A}!

7001202.en: Don't worry, {post|A}, we will leave nothing on the field!
7001202.ch: 请{post|A}放心，我等定用尽毕生所学为我宗赢得胜利！

7002101.en: Thank you for your approval, {post|A}! I'm glad I could bring honor to the Sect!
7002101.ch: 承蒙{post|A}抬爱，弟子定不辱使命！

7002102.en: It's all thanks to you, {post|A}, that I was able to win!
7002102.ch: 弟子侥幸取胜，全仗{post|A}用心栽培！

7002103.en: It's thank to you and your teachings, {post|A}, that I was able to win!

7002201.en: You're talented and humble. Truly a pupil with great potential.
7002201.ch: 天资聪颖，胜而不骄，孺子可教也。

7002202.en: Very well, very well. My teachings have not been in vain.
7002202.ch: 甚好甚好，不负我苦心栽培。

7002203.ch: 合该有此一胜，早在预料之中。

7002301.en: I did terribly... I failed you, {post|A}!
7002301.ch: 恕弟子愚钝无能，辜负了{post|A}的器重！

7002302.en: I should've done better... I failed you and your teachings, {post|A}!
7002302.ch: 弟子难当大任，愧对{post|A}心血！

7002303.en: You've done your best to help me train, {post|A}... I really failed you by losing!
7002303.ch: {post|A}一向对我提携有加，此次落败弟子难辞其咎！

7002401.en: You may have your regrets, but it's not that bad.

7002402.en: No need to be upset. Let's go back to our Sect.

7002403.en: It's good that you understand your own shortcomings. You'll get another chance one day!

7003101.en: Ha, this duel is totally worth it now that I've obtained this.
7003101.ch: 此秘宝为我所用，不枉我煞费苦心准备本次大比！

7003102.en: Thank you, thank you. I'll accept this item, then.
7003102.ch: 承让承让，此物在下就笑纳了。

7003103.en: Even though I won by sheer luck, I'll still accept this item. Haha!
7003103.ch: 侥幸取胜，这宝物在下便却之不恭了，哈哈。

7004101.en: Deploy it on my command and take the enemy by surprise!
7004101.ch: 待我吩咐之时，你就使出此物，定能打对手个措手不及。

7004102.en: Put this item to use when I give you the okay.
7004102.ch: 待我吩咐之时，只管用出此物。

7004103.en: Even with the aid of this item, you can't let your guard down.
7004103.ch: 虽有此物相助，你也不可大意。

7005101.en: With the help of this item, you'll definitely win for sure!
7005101.ch: 有此物加持，你必可取胜！

7005102.en: This treasure is all yours now. It'll help you defeat your enemies!
7005102.ch: 我将此物赠予你，愿能助你轻松取胜。

7005103.en: Keep this item safe and use it when I say so.
7005103.ch: 此物你且收好，届时听我指示行事。

7005201.en: I'm truly honored to be acknowledged by you, {post|A}. I will be victorious for sure!
7005201.ch: 幸得{post|A}垂青，弟子岂敢不胜？

7005202.en: I was able to win because of sheer luck and your teachings, {post|A}.

7005203.en: I've always hoped to win at the Arena and spread {post|A}'s good name.
7005203.ch: 擂台得胜，为{post|A}扬名，乃弟子之愿。

7005302.en: I can't thank you enough. If I'm successful, I'll repay you for sure, {post|A}!
7005302.ch: 大恩不言谢，若弟子有所斩获，定当报{post|A}今日赏识之恩！

7005303.en: Thank you for trusting my skills, {post|A}! I'll do my best!

7005401.en: I see that you're a grateful one. I approve.

7005402.en: Treasures are a luxury, not essentials. No thanks needed.
7005402.ch: 秘宝不过是锦上添花之物，不必言谢。

7005403.en: You're clever, talented, and honorable as well. You have a great future ahead of you!
7005403.ch: 聪明伶俐，德才兼备，此子可堪重用。

7005501.en: I failed... I can no longer bring myself to face you, {post|A}!
7005501.ch: 此番比拼我竟落败于人，弟子实在无颜面对{post|A}。

7005502.en: I lost... I don't deserve your approval, {post|A}!
7005502.ch: 未能取胜，弟子愧对{post|A}的厚爱。

7005503.en: {post|A}, you've always praised me... yet I still ended up like this. I'm so ashamed...
7005503.ch: {post|A}对我重视有加，奈何自己技不如人，实在惭愧。

7005601.en: It's just one match. All you have to do is train harder when we go back.
7005601.ch: 一时战败不必挂记于心，只要日后勤加修炼即可。

7005602.en: You're know where you went wrong. I won't go on about it, as long as you learn your lesson.
7005602.ch: 你既已有惭愧之意，那我便不再多言，只要你能汲取教训就好。

7005603.en: You've still improved a lot. It's fine!
7005603.ch: 想必此次挫折定能让你有所领悟，也罢也罢。

7005701.en: Thanks for the approval, {post|A}. But {post|A} should take care of your own first.
7005701.ch: 谢{post|A}抬爱，但还是优先照顾您堂口下的同门吧。

7005702.en: I'm not one of your disciples. I cannot accept it. I hope you can understand, {post|A}.
7005702.ch: 在下并非您堂口下的弟子，恕在下不可收此物。还望{post|A}理解。

7005703.en: The Elder has other plans for this Treasure. I cannot accept it.
7005703.ch: 弟子所在堂口的长老已对秘宝作了安排，还请您将此宝赠予他人。

7005704.en: Because of my incompetence, I am heavily wounded and may not be able to fight for the sect again. It would be a waste for me to have this Treasure.
7005704.ch: 弟子无能，重伤在身，恐难以为宗门再战，如此秘宝于我无用。

7005705.en: I am heavily wounded and may not be able to fight again. Please don't waste the Treasure on me and save it for our healthy brethren.
7005705.ch: 弟子身负重伤无法再战，切勿浪费秘宝，此物还是给予能够出战的同门为好。

7005706.en: I was heavily wounded in the duel and let the sect down. I'm too ashamed to accept this Treasure.
7005706.ch: 弟子辜负宗门期望，在比斗中受了重伤，实在无颜收取秘宝。

7005707.en: With my body condition, I can't use this Treasure to its fullest. Please allow me to decline this opportunity.
7005707.ch: 我如今的身体即便拿了此秘宝，恐怕也无法物尽其用，恕弟子无法接受宗门栽培。

7005708.en: The Sect Duel is due to start in three months. This event requires ten Sect True Disciples. If we don't have enough True Disciples, we have to pick lower-rank Disciples by their EXP in descending order until we have ten participants. If we don't even have enough Disciples, we will be denied participation in the Sect Duel.
7005708.ch: 宗门大比还有三个月就开始了，本次活动将由十名宗门真传弟子参与，若真传弟子不足，将会按照修为高低从真传以下弟子筛选出足够的弟子参加。若弟子不足本次宗门大比将会弃权。

7005709.en: The participant list is finalized one month before the Sect Duel starts. {callSchool|A}, you are not a True Disciple yet, and if you want to participate in the Sect Duel, please apply to the Sect Leader or a Grand Elder.
7005709.ch: 宗门大比前一个月时将会正式定下出战名额，{callSchool|A}你仍非真传，并无参赛资格，若有参比之心可向宗主或大长老自荐出战。

7005710.en: {callSchool|A}, since we don't have enough True Disciples for the Sect Duel, the Sect Leader and the Elder Cabinet decide to add you to the participant list considering your higher EXP. It is an important event for our sect. Please follow me to the duel ground!
7005710.ch: {callSchool|A}，由于宗门参赛的真传弟子不足，经由宗主和长老阁的商量决定，派门中修为较高的你进行参赛。事关重大，请速随我赶赴大赛会场！

7005711.en: This is the perfect timing to use the Treasure.
7005711.ch: 此刻乃最佳时机，快使出秘宝。

7005712.en: Use the Treasure to best the enemy!
7005712.ch: 快使用秘宝，杀敌人个措手不及。

7005713.en: Why not use the Treasure now? What are you saving it for?
7005713.ch: 何不使出秘宝？此时不用，更待何时！

7005714.en: I'll let you know how good I am!
7005714.ch: 今日就让你瞧瞧我的厉害！

7005715.en: Have you ever seen the power of a Treasure? Well, you'll see it now!
7005715.ch: 你可曾见过秘宝的威力？我现在就让你感受一番！

7005716.en: I have activated the Dragon Gate Treasure. You'd better give up now!
7005716.ch: 我已祭出龙门秘宝，你不如趁早认输！

7006101.en: The {school|A} force soon arrives at the location of the Sect Tournament where you will face heroes of many Sects. Fight with valor, whether it be for glory or profit.
7006101.ch: 不久，{school|A}的队伍抵达了宗门大比之所。无论是为了宗门名誉还是个人利益，面对即将到来的各宗英杰，你都秉持着必胜的决心和信念。

7006102.en: {0} might have been defeated, but if the Disciples have learned something, then the experience has not been in vain.
7006102.ch: 由于种种原因，{0}最终在这次宗门大比中败下阵来。不过，若宗门弟子们能从中有所感悟，那也不枉此行。

7006103.en: After several days of grueling battles, {0} emerges victorious and is crowned Champion.
7006103.ch: 历经数日苦战，一切最终尘埃落定，{0}拔得头筹，摘下桂冠，在八荒中立下了赫赫威名。

7006104.en: {1}, talented youth from {0}, defeated one powerful cultivator after another and earned the praise of the entire arena as well as the title of Champion. {2} will receive amazing rewards!
7006104.ch: {0}的青年才俊{1}力敌各路英豪，愈战愈勇，在场之人皆赞不绝口，不愧为此次宗门大比之魁首也。{2}魁首将会收获此次大比的丰厚奖励。

7006105.en: {school|A} Disciples, thank you for joining the Sect Duel. Please take a rest first. During every rest period, the Sect Leader and Elders may buy items for their Disciples in the Treasury. !! Test !!
7006105.ch: 辛苦{school|A}的各位前来参加宗门大比，大家先休整一下，长老以及宗主每次休整都可以进秘宝阁为弟子购买道具。！！测试！！

7006108.en: The Sect Duel will commence tomorrow. Please rest here for the night. During the rest, the Sect Leader and Elders may enter the Treasury to seek Treasures for Commission Disciples.
7006108.ch: 宗门大比明日开战，请各位师兄师姐先于此地休整一晚。在休整期间，宗主及各位长老可进入秘宝阁为督战的弟子求取秘宝。

7006109.en: During every rest period in the Sect Duel, the Sect Leader and Elders may enter the Treasury to seek Treasures for Commission Disciples.
7006109.ch: 在宗门大比休整期间，宗主及各位长老可进入秘宝阁为督战弟子求取对战秘宝。

7006106.en: Introduce Points Race basic rules !! Test !!
7006106.ch: 介绍积分赛基本规则！！测试！！

7006107.en: There you are, {callSchool|A}! The Sect Tournament is starting. Let's report back to the Sect!
7006107.ch: {callSchool|A}，总算找到你了，宗门大比就要开始了，我们赶快回宗门报道吧！

7006202.en: The treasures of the Dragon Gate are within reach. Your performance will determine whether our journey will be lucrative!
7006202.ch: 龙门秘宝已近在眼前，此行能否振我宗威名、扬我宗风采，就看诸位的表现了！

7006204.en: {callSchool|A}, finally found you! The Sect Tournament is about to begin. Our Sect has a Secret Technique that would let you temporarily step down from your position and disguise yourself as a True Disciple to take part in the Sect Tournament. Are you willing?
7006204.ch: {callSchool|A}，总算找到您了！宗门大比即将开始，若您想参加大比，我宗现有一秘法，可让您暂时卸下职位，伪装成真传弟子出战，请问您可愿意？

7006301.en: We'll keep your advice in mind!

7006302.en: No need to worry about us!

7006401.en: The Mystic Realm, Dragon Gate, doesn't open its gates often. Countless skilled cultivators have congregated here to challenge themselves. And the champion will be decided—today!
7006401.ch: 龙门秘境，数载一遇。宗门英杰，尽数而出。天道渺远，上下求索。斩将夺魁，就在今朝。

7006501.en: As soon as you take the treasure, a bright light bursts out of the Lotus Pavilion, obscuring your sight and spiritual senses all at once.
7006501.ch: 待你取走宝物后，莲台突然光芒大作，你的视线和灵识都被蒙蔽。

7006502.en: A moment later, a spiritual breeze gently lifts you up and sends you back to the spot where the Sect Disciples are resting.
7006502.ch: 片刻后，一阵充满灵力的微风将你推扶着，沿来时之路把你送回到了宗门弟子休憩的地方。

7006503.en: It all feels like a dream to you, except what you took from the lotus pavilion is still in your hand. You distribute the treasure to the Disciples to give them a boost in their duels.
7006503.ch: 你只觉这一切恍然若梦，但从莲台处所获之物却仍旧握在手中。你似乎明白，将其分发给宗门弟子，便可让他们在比斗中获得助益。

7006601.en: You have traveled far to be here. There will be {0} sects competing in this Tournament.
7006601.ch: 舟车劳顿实在辛苦，本次宗门大比有{0}这几个宗门参加。

7006602.en: Please collect these treasures and distribute them among your Disciples. They will help them perform to their maximum potential in the battles.
7006602.ch: 有劳各位前辈求取秘宝，待诸位将其赐予督战的弟子，这些秘宝便可帮助他们在比斗中大放异彩。

7006603.en: The Sect Tournament occurs in two parts, Points Race and Open Challenge Match. The Points Race takes place over {2} rounds, with victory going to the winner of {0}/{1} matches. The <#791515>Top {3}</color> places in the Points Race <#791515>advance</color> into the Open Challenge Match. The Sect Tournament is not full contact. Focus on using the Tao.
7006603.ch: 宗门大比分为积分赛和擂台赛。积分赛共会进行{2}轮比赛，每轮比试以{0}局{1}胜赛制决出本轮胜负，积分赛<#791515>前{3}</color>甲即可<#791515>晋级</color>擂台赛。宗门大比点道为止，请各位尽情切磋道法。

7006604.en: Opposing Sect Leaders choose their Disciples for the match. Defeated Disciples will be Heavily Wounded. Unless healed with a specific Treasure, these Disciples will not be able to participate in subsequent matches.
7006604.ch: 双方宗主会选出弟子进行一轮对战，战败的弟子会进入重伤状态。除非使用特定秘宝恢复，否则此人将无缘参加后续比试。

7006605.en: When selecting Disciples, the winner of the previous match chooses their Disciples first. And don't worry, your Sect will always be the second to perform an action in the first round!
7006605.ch: 在弟子选择阶段，上一回合的胜者将会在下一回合优先派出弟子，本师妹已经提前替宗门打点过了，所以我宗第一回合永远是后手出战哦~

7006606.en: In the Points Race, the Sect that wins 3 matches wins the round. Every victory earns 3 points, draws earn 1 point, and losses earn no points. That's about it. I look forward to your triumphant return!
7006606.ch: 在积分赛中，每轮对阵获胜三个回合的宗门，即本轮直接胜利。每轮胜利可获得3点积分，平局获得1点，输掉则无积分。简要的介绍就到这里，期望我宗旗开得胜、凯旋而归！

7006607.en: The Open Challenge Match is about to begin! In Open Challenge Matches points are awarded to both Sects and Individuals. Every time a Disciple defeats an enemy, they earn 1 point for their Sect as well as 1 point for themselves. Deploy disciples as appropriate. Disciples can be deployed one time only and defeated disciples cannot be redeployed.
7006607.ch: 擂台赛即将开始！擂台赛分为宗门积分榜与个人积分榜，弟子在擂台上每击败一人，将给所在宗门增加1积分，同时给弟子本人增加1积分。弟子可酌情考虑是否上擂，每人仅有一次机会，被击败后不可二次上擂。

7006608.en: In the Open Challenge Matches, Disciples can decide whether or not to deploy, depending on the situation.
7006608.ch: 在擂台赛中，弟子可以自己按照目前比赛的情况考虑并选择是否上擂。

7006609.en: With each Disciple who wins a duel onstage, the Sect receives 1 point, and the Disciple themselves also receives 1 point. The Disciples who lose will not be able to go onstage again. The key to victory is to get as many wins as you can!
7006609.ch: 弟子上擂后获得胜利，会给宗门积1分，同时给个人积1分，战败的弟子就无法再次上擂了。只要在擂台上多多取胜，宗门便能在大比中满载而归！

7006701.en: I won't let our Sect down!

7006702.en: I may not be skilled, but I'll still do my best!
7006702.ch: 弟子虽实力低微，但必定拼尽全力！

7006704.en: Heat up the wine, I'll be right back!

7006705.en: Piece of cake. I'll handle it in a jiffy!

7006706.en: A useless opponent. I could take them down with one finger.
7006706.ch: 不堪一击的对手，弹指可败。

7006802.en: I've failed you and your expectations, Leader...

7006803.en: The Sect taught me so much... yet I failed you all!

7006804.en: I didn't expect the opponent to be so tough...

7006902.en: I've repaid the Sect with my victory!

7006903.ch: 回禀宗主，此局已然赢下！

7006904.en: Victory is already mine. My opponent never had a chance.
7006904.ch: 胜负早已决定，对手挣扎乃徒劳。

7006905.en: The moment you summoned me, Leader, the result of the match has been determined.
7006905.ch: 宗主唤我那一刻，本局赛果就已然确定。

7006906.en: I hope my next opponent is more of a challenge.
7006906.ch: 麻烦下次宗主替我挑个有趣点的对手。

7007001.en: (You're heading to the Sect Duel now. As the leader, what will you say to your Disciples?)
7007001.ch: （将要出发前往宗门大比，作为宗主想对弟子说什么？）

7007103.en: All participants will be rewarded according to their performance in the Duel. Do your best and leave no regrets!
7007103.ch: 此番大比，论功行赏，望诸位拼尽全力，不留遗憾！

7007002.en: (How will you respond to the Leader?)

7007301.en: Congratulations on receiving a Treasure! This is a divine item with a unique and powerful effect given to you by sect Elders. <#791515>Activate it during the Sect Duel</color>, and it can turn the tide of battle.
7007301.ch: 恭喜阁下获得秘宝！此物乃是宗门长老给予阁下的神物，具备独特而强大的效果。在<#791515>比斗之时将其催动</color>，瞬息扭转战局。

7007302.en: The best part is that this Treasure is not subject to the rules of Dragon Gate Mystic Realm and can be used in duels. All the sects acquiesce in its use.
7007302.ch: 最为特殊的一点是，该秘宝不受龙门秘境的法则限制，可以在擂台比斗之时使用而出，八荒各大宗门也默许了这一点。

7007303.en: So feel free to use it during a duel to turn the tide of battle. Activate it at the most critical moment!
7007303.ch: 故阁下不必有所顾虑，在比斗之时，若需要使用秘宝来扭转战局，还请放心大胆地将其用出，切勿错失良机！

7007401.en: {0}, congratulations on advancing to the Open Challenge Matches! This time there is a 7-day rest period to let all the participants recover to <#791515>better conditions</color>. The Sect Leader and Elders may pick <#791515>more Treasures</color> in the Treasury to prepare their Disciples for the Open Challenge Matches.
7007401.ch: 恭喜{0}成功晋级擂台赛！此次会进行为时七天的休整，让各位参赛弟子恢复<#791515>更好的状态</color>，长老及宗主可在秘宝阁选择<#791515>更多的秘宝</color>，为弟子们擂台赛最后的角逐做准备。

7007402.en: Now we'll have a long rest period, after which the Open Challenge Matches will start.
7007402.ch: 接下来会进入一段较长的休整时间，休整完毕后将会开启擂台赛了。

7007403.en: Since this is a long rest period, our Disciples can recover to a better condition, and more Treasures can be acquired. Have a good rest and get prepared for the Open Challenge Matches!
7007403.ch: 因为本次休整时间比较长，所以弟子们恢复的状态会更多，本次休整能获得的秘宝也更多。这段时间辛苦各位了，请好好歇息备战擂台赛吧！

7007501.en: The first round of Points Race has finished. <#791515>Every round of rest</color> restores 20% of HP lost for the Disciples. Heavily wounded Disciples need <#791515>Heavy Wound Recovery</color> Treasures to fight again.
7007501.ch: 第一轮积分赛顺利结束， <#791515>每次休整</color>都可以恢复弟子们已损失生命值的20%哦，重伤的弟子需要得到<#791515>恢复重伤</color>的秘宝才可再次上场。

7007502.en: A Disciple gets heavily wounded after losing in a match. A heavily wounded Disciple cannot fight again unless treated with a special Treasure.
7007502.ch: 弟子若是在之前的比赛中落败会身受重伤，重伤的弟子无法再上阵，可以通过特别的秘宝重新恢复。

7007503.en: If no Disciples are selected for a Points Race or there are not enough eligible Disciples, it is counted as a forfeit. If both teams forfeit, this round is counted as a draw. Please pay close attention to the participant Disciples' conditions while taking the next few rounds into account.
7007503.ch: 若积分赛中不选择弟子或无可出战弟子则视为本局弃权，双方弃权则本回合视为平局，请一定要慎重考虑出战弟子的状态保存实力应对未来几轮的竞赛。

7007601.en: As you keep walking, you arrive at a place where you are startled by a stir of breath, only to find your fellow traveler is nowhere to be found.
7007601.ch: 走着走着，来到了一处地方，一阵气息晃动，你赫然发现身边的人已经不知所踪。

7007602.en: You suddenly see three lotus thrones towering ahead. The offering platform reminds you that it must be the Treasury mentioned by your junior, where you can offer Spirit Stones to acquire Treasures.
7007602.ch: 取而代之的是面前赫然耸立的三座莲花台，看到莲花台前面的供奉台，你思索此地方应该就是小师妹所说供奉灵石取得秘宝的秘宝阁。

7007701.en: As you are about to start meditation, you see the Sect Leaders and Elders of all the sects flying on their swords toward a place brimming with Qi. It turns out they are going there to seek Treasures to give to their Disciples before every fight to strengthen them.
7007701.ch: 你正准备打坐调息运转周天的时候，发现各宗宗主和长老们正朝着远处一个灵气涌动之地御剑飞去。此行乃是他们前去求取秘宝，将于每轮对战前赠予弟子们以助力宗门取胜。

7007702.en: You feel powerful energy coming from their destination, and overhear some Disciples saying their leaders are heading there to seek Treasures for them to strengthen them in battles.
7007702.ch: 你从他们的行进的方向处感受到异常强大的灵力，偶尔听到其他弟子耳语，此去是各大宗门领导者们前往求取秘宝并配与弟子以助力取胜。

7007801.en: The Sect Competition has finished, and the Dragon Gate Organization has opened the Mystic Realm for the top sects in the competition rankings. The sects are requested to enter the Mystic Realm and claim Treasures in the order of their rankings.
7007801.ch: 宗门大比已结束，龙门组织按照宗门比试排名分别开放秘境，请各宗门按照排名有序进入秘境领取宝藏。

7007802.en: Our sect won the first place in the Sect Competition this time. Please follow our Sect Leader into the Mystic Realm and claim Dragon Gate Treasures!
7007802.ch: 本次大比本宗获得了头筹的优秀战绩，请随宗主进入秘境，取得龙门宝藏！

7007803.en: Our sect members followed Sect Leader into the Mystic Realm and obtained a decent amount of Treasures!
7007803.ch: 宗门各位随宗主进入了秘境，经过一番探索，获得了不少宝藏！

7007804.en: You have wrapped up the Treasures and are about to leave the Mystic Realm when a bright light flashes in front of you and leaves a luxurious box behind. On it is carved the word "Champion". Apparently, it is the special Treasure reserved for you as the champion!
7007804.ch: 获得了宝藏后，你准备离开秘境，一道光芒从天而降，飘落在你面前的是一个无比华贵的宝盒，宝盒上赫然印着“魁首”二字。显然这是为取得魁首的你特别准备的宝物！

7007805.en: Our sect won the second place in the Sect Competition this time. Please follow our Sect Leader into the Mystic Realm and claim Dragon Gate Treasures!
7007805.ch: 本次大比本宗获得了次席的优秀战绩，请随宗主进入秘境，取得龙门宝藏！

7007806.en: Our sect won the last place in the Sect Competition this time. Please follow our Sect Leader into the Mystic Realm and claim Dragon Gate Treasures!
7007806.ch: 本次大比本宗获得了末席的优秀战绩，请随宗主进入秘境，取得龙门宝藏！

7007901.en: {0} was obtained from the Dragon Gate Treasury just now and is now awarded to you. Hope you will win the fight!
7007901.ch: {0}是方才于龙门秘宝阁中求取，现赠于你，比试务必取胜！

7007903.en: Our sect won the {0} in the Sect Competition last month. Sect Leader asked us to hold a celebration, and all our Disciples may go to the Sect <#791515>Honor List</color> now to claim a gift.
7007903.ch: 本宗在上个月宗门大比取得了{0}的好成绩，宗主下令庆祝一番，所有弟子均可以前往宗门<#791515>荣誉榜</color>处领取庆礼。

7007906.en: The Sect Competition has finished. Please follow me to leave the Dragon Gate.
7007906.ch: 本次宗门大比结束，请各位随我离开龙门。

7007907.en: This battle is already lost. I'd rather save strength for the next battle.
7007907.ch: 这样下去我必败无疑，不如保存实力下一场再战。

7007908.en: You are stronger than me. I concede defeat.
7007908.ch: 是我技不如人，遇上你这般强劲的对手，我甘拜下风。

7007909.en: I'd rather quit than be defeated. You win.
7007909.ch: 与其被击败，不如潇洒离场。我承认你很强，我认输。

7007911.ch: 今日与你一战，也算是棋逢对手了。
